jobs.title: School Nurse - IEP Case Manager
jobs.description:
Credentialed School Nurse (CSN) – IEP Health Assessments

Part-Time | Per Diem W-2 | Hybrid/Remote | $65/hour

Backstage Health is seeking a California Credentialed School Nurse (CSN) to complete IEP-related health assessments for virtual academy students. This flexible, assignment-based position is ideal for a school nurse looking for supplemental work that can be completed largely on their own schedule.

Most responsibilities are completed remotely. In-person travel is primarily for vision and hearing screenings, which are coordinated directly with families based on mutual availability.

Responsibilities

* Complete initial and triennial IEP health assessments
* Review medical, developmental, and educational records
* Interview parents/guardians and gather relevant health history
* Prepare individualized School Nurse Health Assessment Reports
* Complete in-person vision and hearing screenings
* Coordinate screening appointments directly with families
* Participate virtually in IEP meetings and present health findings when required
* Collaborate with parents, case managers, educators, and multidisciplinary teams
* Maintain timely and accurate documentation using secure electronic systems

Required Qualifications

* Active California RN license
* California School Nurse Services Credential — Preliminary or Clear
* California School Audiometrist Certificate
* Strong clinical documentation and communication skills
* Comfortable working independently and managing assignment deadlines
* Reliable computer, internet access, and transportation

What We Offer

* $65/hour, per diem W-2 employment
* Travel time paid at $30/hour
* Mileage reimbursement
* 401(k) with matching
* Flexible, assignment-based scheduling
* Remote work for most assessment responsibilities
* In-person appointments scheduled around nurse and family availability
* Evening and weekend appointments available when mutually convenient
* Year-round assignments, including summer opportunities

This is a great opportunity for credentialed school nurses who already work full-time or part-time and are looking for flexible supplemental school nursing work without committing to a traditional campus schedule.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Salary Range: 110k-142k

Replacement

The Global Trade Compliance team operates across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions in close collaboration with Husky’s Legal department. The team defines, implements, and continuously improves processes and policies to ensure compliance with global export control, sanctions, and customs regulations.

As the Global Trade Compliance Program Manager, you will report to the Director, Global Trade Compliance & Customs and serve as the program lead for enterprise-wide trade compliance initiatives. This role will focus on managing global compliance projects, optimizing processes, and ensuring the successful integration of trade compliance requirements into Husky’s systems.

You will partner with cross-functional teams—including Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Sales—to strengthen Husky’s global trade compliance framework, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce compliance risk across all regions.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Project Management

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of global trade compliance initiatives, including process optimization, technology integration, and system enhancements.

Manage the implementation of trade compliance modules within the ERP system to ensure alignment with global regulatory requirements.

Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.

Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.

Regulatory Compliance and Oversight

Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.

Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.

Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.

Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.

Classification, Licensing, and Documentation

Lead efforts to standardize global product classification processes, including export control, HTS, and country-of-origin determinations.

Develop and maintain processes for end-use/end-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.

Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

Conduct global risk assessments and audits to evaluate compliance performance and identify improvement opportunities.

Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.

Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Training, Communication, and Stakeholder Engagement

Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.

Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.

Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.

Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

Required Experience & Education

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.

Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.

Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.

Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.

Demonstrated ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a global environment.

Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.

Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.

Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.

Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.

Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.

Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.

Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.

new_jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

1. About Our Client:

This organization operates within the Search AI industry, enabling users to find answers in real time across large-scale data environments. Their platform integrates search precision with AI intelligence to accelerate meaningful results, handling both structured and unstructured data securely. Serving over half of the Fortune 500, this team offers cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability, addressing challenges around data accessibility and privacy protection.

2. About the Opportunity:

The Senior Program Manager, Pricing and Packaging
role is part of the Product Finance team and focuses on partnering with the Product organization to bring new offerings to market. The position involves managing complex cross-functional coordination to ensure pricing and packaging initiatives are successfully launched, directly impacting how products are monetized and delivered.

3. Responsibilities:

Drive alignment among stakeholders including FP&A, Revenue, Legal, IT, and Billing to execute pricing and packaging changes.
Hold stakeholders accountable to timelines and decisions, ensuring clear communication and priority translation across functions.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of SaaS pricing models and monetization strategies such as tiering, bundling, and usage-based models.
Map and document launch processes to create scalable, repeatable playbooks and recommend improvements to reduce time-to-market.
Track open items, owners, dependencies, and approvals for all active launches, enforcing rigorous progress monitoring and follow-up.
Identify and escalate potential blockers to maintain launch schedules and monetization integrity.

4. Requirements:

Over 10 years of program or project management experience within product organizations of SaaS or technology companies.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional product launches from inception to completion.
Experience collaborating with Product, Finance, Legal, and Systems teams.
Strong verbal and written communication skills tailored to technical, business, and executive audiences.
Curiosity about product details to ask relevant questions and advocate for process improvements.
